mainEntity.name: How do I know whether AI is really helping my small business or just making more work?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Look for evidence that the workflow improves a defined business measure, not merely that the AI produces impressive text. Useful measures include preparation time, correction time, response consistency, qualified inquiries, completed tasks, or publishing accuracy.

Context: Run My AI Biz describes demonstrations, examples, and adaptable bot blueprints rather than 38 guaranteed income-producing businesses. Outcomes depend on the owner’s offer, audience, inputs, tools, review, and execution.

Key factors:
- A baseline before implementation
- A consistent test period
- Quality and accuracy checks
- Clear success criteria

Practical guidance: Save a few examples of the old process, run the AI-assisted version, and compare like with like. Track both gains and hidden work, including correcting facts or formatting.

Run My AI Biz encourages practical testing instead of treating a prompt as proof of profitability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure the workflow against a baseline. Track time to completion, correction effort, output quality, and a business result such as qualified inquiries or completed follow-up. Include hidden review time, because faster drafts are not useful if they create extra errors.
